column1: # session batch 1 (public entry points whose call sites pin them)
# NetworkOpcode / ServerState: enums carrying a wire code; the byte accessor and its inverse lookup
#   -> getCode / fromCode (same shape as the other byte-coded enums in this tree).
# GameClient: MultiplayerGameMode pins four entry points - GameClient.a(AddressProvider,
#   MatchRecord) is the factory -> create ; a() starts the connection thread -> start ;
#   e() is handed to saveStore.saveWorld -> getWorld ; h() is called from disconnect()
#   -> disconnect.
# GameServer: a(World) is the factory -> create ; a(AddressProvider, PortMappingCallback) registers
#   the match and opens the server socket -> start ; b(World) forwards to shareTerrainFrom
#   -> shareTerrain ; a() is the MatchRecord MultiplayerGameMode reuses -> getMatchRecord.
# Everything else in this package (the rest of GameClient/GameServer, the synthetic accessors that
# exist only for ServerTickThread/ServerClientSession, ServerClientSession itself, the mode
# subclasses' d/e/f hooks) is left obfuscated for now: each needs its own call-site study, and the
# network code has no automated test beyond the boot smoke check.
